summary.text: Cathi Forbes is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 43B and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was the only candidate in the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
Her legislative biography lists earlier work in marketing and as a mediation coordinator for the Baltimore County Orphans' Court.

paragraphs.text: Cathi Forbes was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and graduated from Charles F. Brush High School in Lyndhurst, Ohio.
She earned a B.A. in English and art history from Allegheny College in 1987.
Forbes held marketing and information roles at Henry J. Kaufman & Associates, TCOM Systems, Inc. and Barton Cotton between 1987 and 1994, according to her legislative biography.

She volunteered with Baltimore public schools from 2000 to 2016, managed Mike Ertel's 2009-2010 campaign for Baltimore County Council, and served as mediation coordinator for the Baltimore County Orphans' Court from 2014 to 2019.
Ballotpedia lists Forbes as the only candidate in the 2026 Democratic primary for District 43B, in which she received 4,241 votes.
She is a member of the Appropriations Committee, according to the General Assembly website.
